text: If the zombie apocalypse starts on a cruise ship, you can't run.
Then the screaming starts on the pool deck. The apocalypse starts.
Rule one. Don't take the lift.
Everyone crowds in. Then the doors open on the next deck.
Rule two. Head up, not down.
The lower decks are cramped and dark. Up top, you can see what's coming.
Rule three. Hit the buffet on your way.
Grab bottled water and bread rolls. Light, filling, and nobody's guarding them.
And grab the ship's cat. Trust me.
By morning, you've barricaded yourself in the bridge.
The captain's chair is empty. The ship is drifting.
Then you spot a lifeboat. Your way off this ship.
But something's already inside it. And it's moving.
